issue.public_name: Saved contact import mapping cannot be loaded after its owner is deactivated
issue.exact_error: We couldn't load this import mapping. Ask an admin to duplicate the mapping and try again. (MAP-403)

affected.condition: The selected saved mapping was created by a workspace member who has since been deactivated.

not_affected: Fresh CSV imports that do not select a saved mapping
CSV column validation or file-encoding errors
issue.public_cause: A saved mapping keeps its original owner's access reference. If that owner is deactivated, the mapping cannot be loaded.

approved_workaround.action: Sign in as an active Workspace Admin.
Go to Settings > Data management > Import mappings.
Filter Owner status to Deactivated and locate the affected mapping.
Open the mapping's actions menu and select Duplicate.
Give the copy a distinct name, set its owner to an active Workspace Admin, and select Save.
Return to Contacts > Import, upload the CSV, and select the duplicated mapping.
Review the field preview and select Run import.

verification: Activity > Imports shows the run as Completed and displays imported and skipped row counts.

escalation.when: The duplicate still produces MAP-403, or no active Workspace Admin can access Import mappings.
escalation.privacy_note: Do not attach the source CSV unless Support specifically requests it through the secure upload flow.

do_not_recommend: Do not reactivate a former member just to regain access to the mapping.
Do not tell customers to change CSV headers for MAP-403.
Do not promise a fix date; no target release is approved.
